Caption: Decayed Haussmannian hallway with crooked painted portraits whose faces have faded but eyes remain intact.

STYLE.Cultural / Historical Influence: Paris early 2000s–2010s cinematic realism, older period details where appropriate

COMPOSITION.Layout: long hallway vanishing point and pictures on walls

CINEMATOGRAPHY_AND_LIGHTING.Lighting Style: low-key amber practical lights with cold shadow edges
CINEMATOGRAPHY_AND_LIGHTING.Color Palette: dirty beige, tobacco brown, oxidized gold, cool shadow

CAMERA_AND_LENS.Camera Type and Era: DV camcorder, early 2000s, with anamorphic adapter
CAMERA_AND_LENS.Lens Effects: subtle horizontal blue or amber anamorphic streaks, gentle halation, mild highlight blooming, DV-era edge softness
CAMERA_AND_LENS.Depth of Field: shallow to medium, architecture readable where needed
CAMERA_AND_LENS.Film Grain / Noise: subtle MiniDV digital noise, restrained chroma noise and compression texture, no added 35mm film grain

PHYSICAL_ATTRIBUTES.Material & Texture: dusty oil paint, frames and cracked plaster
PHYSICAL_ATTRIBUTES.Execution Style: realistic in-camera practical lighting, filmic exposure
